scope: Technical review of 59 root captures and five entry preparation views

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Boiler face, circular needle gauge, sight tube, dark access panels, base and overhead pipe couplings are visible.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: All three glazed fronts and the timber surround are visible. Several books and a small vessel can be seen through the panes, with a lit doorway to the right.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The gray center elevation shows repeated window bays, a projecting cornice and a broad dark roof with a tank and aerial supports.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The center parapet and window rows read under dusk lighting. A narrow warm strip appears at the base and adjacent panes at right are lit.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The gray brick elevation, rows of rectangular sash windows and shallow roofline are visible against blue sky.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The red center elevation has a recessed middle bay, pale window sills, a parapet outline and a warm hipped rooftop structure on the left.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The pale window rows, U-shaped parapet and warm hipped structure at upper left remain distinguishable.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The three sides of the recessed red-brick bay enclose a strip of blue sky. Window surrounds, sills and horizontal trim remain visible.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A dark roof with repeating dormers tops the far facade. In the lower foreground an orange-edged structure and its parallel rails are visible.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Dormers and pale window rows remain visible above the warmly lit lower framework. Much of the yard is silhouette.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Window and sill rhythms remain readable across the tall facade, with dormers making a stepped silhouette above.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The ochre roof inset and pale border sit above a red elevation with a projecting middle bay. The neighboring windows show warm tones.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Warm inset roof and pale cornice edge are visible over a dim red facade. Nearby panes show isolated warm light.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A projecting stone balcony or balustrade, stacked sash windows and the arched top-center opening read against a split roofline.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The stepped parapet, arched upper windows, tank stands, dishes and guy wires are visible among adjoining rooftops.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Stepped roof, arch tops, tanks and rooftop wires remain visible with warmer adjacent panes.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: An inset central stack and arched upper opening divide the pale windows on each side. A dark railing enters along the lower edge.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The broad ochre roof, dark border, tank, dish, fine wires and a prominent cornice are visible above symmetrical sash rows.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Warm light across the broad roof reveals long tank and aerial shadows. The cornice silhouette and pale window rows remain readable below.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A central inset bay with a curved upper window sits between repeated sash rows and an articulated roof cornice under blue sky.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Layered cloud streaks, sloping antenna wires and two dark rooftop tank silhouettes are distinct. Small rooftop fixtures supply orientation, with little roof surface in frame.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Two narrow parallel edge strips recede to the truss silhouette. Small raised shapes form a regular line on the lower side. The slope and strip edges are distinguishable.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The thin retaining edge crosses the dark water and raised right bank. The shot gives little detail across the water.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A dark masonry corner, sidewalk and curb are distinguishable. The blocks behind it fade into fog; most foreground surface detail is in shadow.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Three nearby facade planes step back across the image. The large right block has a regular lit and unlit window grid, with roof and cornice profiles against the clouds.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Roof parapets, rods and wiring sit against the cloud field. A long truss and two raised spans are visible beyond the rooftops to the right.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Curb and storefronts define the street corridor. A dark vehicle now sits in the center foreground; warm storefront glazing remains distinguishable.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A long lighter diagonal band crosses between two dark planes. Its near edge stays readable in the original, with a sharp change in ground tone beneath it and a stepped far horizon.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The low diagonal edge separates the recessed dark field and sloped near ground. The frame establishes silhouette more clearly than surface detail.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The foreground bank edge cuts diagonally across the lower frame. Across the dark span, a line of buildings has alternating light and dark windows with a truss visible at far left.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Tall pale panes and a small interior silhouette are visible behind dark roof trim and masonry. Rooftop tanks and aerials silhouette against the sky.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The two nearest panes show distinct blocky interior shapes. Window trim and red brick remain legible through the foreground steelwork.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Two adjacent gray panes show distinct tall cabinet and low tabletop silhouettes; the warmer panes below show additional interior shapes behind the sash bars.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The gray molded surrounds, arched red-brick window heads and stepped trim are visible. Adjacent cool panes show different interior forms, and warm foreground panes show tables and wall depth.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Foreground brick courses, projecting trim and a partially visible blind give scale. An awning, curved street lamp and receding left roofs mark the street corridor.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Unobstructed fronts show distinct roof silhouettes, masonry, cornices and doors. Divided panes vary between warm and cool tones.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Blue sky and scattered pale cloud patches dominate, with antenna and tank silhouettes at the bottom. The distant rooftop outlines are more distinct than in the other weather views.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A pale layered cloud field and softened silhouettes distinguish this frame from the dry view. Near tank silhouettes and wires remain identifiable at both sides.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: A nearly uniform gray sky grades warmer near the horizon. Dark tank shapes and fine mast wires remain visible in the original, with distant roof forms reduced to silhouettes.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The wide view shows water tanks, antennas and rooflines below layered clouds. The bridge truss is legible at the far right, with scattered warm window rectangles across the distant blocks.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Tile, painted upper wall, vertical strip and part of the toilet are visible. The bypass service connection is out of view.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The larger view confirms a close dark brick corner obstructs the camera. The dumbwaiter itself cannot be reviewed in this frame.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Ground view shows the lit entrance, dark facades, cloud streaks and a person in the near foreground. The handheld overlays the right side.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: High oblique view shows pale roof bulkheads, parapets and lit windows behind the handheld. The lower streets are dark.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Level reverse view shows the broad gray facade and rows of windows across a dark street. The handheld partly obscures the right foreground.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Opposite high oblique view shows the same pale bulkheads with nearer lit windows and railings at left. The street and shafts are dark.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The restored close view shows door panes, brass handle and letter slot under warm light. The companion and dark edge elements occupy the right side.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Warm plank floor, two tables, shelves, doorway and rear radiator are visible. The handheld overlaps the right shelving.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Curtain occupies the left third, with spotlight on tile and painted wall. The toilet is cropped at the lower edge.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Radiator and shaded window on the left, chair and round table in front, and a standing figure beside the lit entry. The handheld overlaps right shelving.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Plank floor, table, chair, radiator and rear shaded window are visible. The pendant is clipped at the top and the handheld obscures the right table.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The frame shows the sink, pipework, cabinets and wall finish. A strong warm center spot and mottled surround limit fine optical comparisons.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Open door, fuse and socket rows, upper feeds and a light-colored lower conduit are visible. The conduit exits the frame at the bottom.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Mailbox rows and mail slot remain recognizable against the dark recessed wall. Small labels are hard to read.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Radiator ribs and valve partly visible below the window beside the side table. A large pale foreground form obscures the left edge; the floor connection is cropped.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Roof landing shows fenced machinery, conduit, stairs and roof sign. Cage bars cross the drive surfaces.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Tank, catwalk and legs silhouette clearly against streaked clouds and surrounding roofs. Dark structural faces limit detailed texture inspection.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Low street view shows a gray front with stone surrounds, red brick fronts with varied arch shapes and warm and cool panes. The right flank is dark.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Terminal casing and green light spill are visible beside the wall board. This angle looks past the casing and does not show the front controls.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: The frame resolves painted wall, glazed tile, toilet cistern, support bars and cropped seat. The deep service fitting is outside the frame.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Colorful pool and curled surface are visible in the warm beam beneath the radiator. A still cannot show the rate or path of flow.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Reddish upright and curled forms stand in front of the radiator under the warm beam. Their silhouette is clear; a still cannot establish motion.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Toaster face, open tray with separate crumb flecks, kettle and nearby vessels are visible.

frames.method: Paired contact sheets and selected larger frames
frames.observation: Station 1 plate and a brass circular part stand out against a dark wall. Fixture detail is limited by low light.
